name: challenge
description: A sense that you are in an environment where you are challenged in some way.

variations.name: physical contest
variations.description: A low stakes conflict with someone or something where physical strength, dexterity, tools, and/or skill will decide the outcome.

variations.name: combat
variations.description: A high stakes conflict with someone or something where physical strength, dexterity, tools, and/or skill will decide the outcome.

variations.name: social contest
variations.description: A conflict with someone or something where social factors such as wit, appearance, or personality will decide the outcome.

variations.name: chance contest
variations.description: A conflict with someone or something where luck will decide the outcome.

variations.name: rule contest
variations.description: A conflict with someone or something where presenting propositions based on a specific rule context will be the base of the outcome.

variations.name: fair contest
variations.description: A conflict where the rules of engagement are followed.

variations.name: unfair contest
variations.description: A conflict where one or more contestants goes against the rules of engagement.

variations.name: subjective contest
variations.description: A conflict where the rules are not clear so the results may be determined by hidden preferences of the judge.

commentaries.quote: Every life and every good story has tension that comes from not knowing the outcome of a branching future that isn't certain. Striving for a particular branch using the appropriate assets is the experience of the challenge.

There are many inspiring quotes about self-improvement through competition and in trying to control the future. These have truth and value, but there's also value in knowing when to let the future take care of itself.

All contests involve two or more participants and some kind of judge. The 'judge' may be an impartial third party, an established set of rules and bystanders, the contestants themselves, or the laws of physics. Many contests have clear rules, but many informal contests don't. Who can decide which person is 'smarter' or 'more attractive'?

conditions: A sense that you are in an environment where you are challenged to encourage or avoid a particular future.
